blocks.text: 20 questions from the course's one chapter with exercises, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Verbal Aspect. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.q: Готов поспорить с тобой, что первым ___ (добежать) до дерева.
exercises.prompt: I'll bet that I can beat you to the tree.
I'll go and start the car.
I doubt if sanctions will work.

exercises.q: Отправка этих писем не ___ (занять) много времени.
exercises.prompt: The sending of these letters won't take long.
Would you mind opening the window?
"Is it fine to change the channel?" "Mm, yeah."
Can I open the window? It's boiling hot in here.
Let's go out on the balcony.
Let's keep an eye on Tom.

exercises.q: Я ___ (посадить) у себя в саду акацию.
exercises.prompt: I'm going to plant an acacia tree in my garden.

exercises.q: Если не складывать одежду или не вешать её, она ___ (помяться).
exercises.prompt: If you don't fold your clothes or hang them, they will be wrinkled.
You'll feel better in no time.
I can't stand people who chew gum loudly.
I admit that I'm tired.
He'll soon catch up with Tom.
I'll take you to school.
Let's move over to that table.

exercises.q: Вот моя рука. Вместе мы ___ (создать) утопию, ты и я.
exercises.prompt: Take my hand. We'll build a utopia, you and me.
Let’s join hands, friends!
He's going to join our club.
Let Tom have his fun.
Who will the jury believe?
Will this affect tourism?

exercises.q: Вопли и крики никуда тебя не ___ (привести).
exercises.prompt: Yelling and screaming is not going to get you anywhere.

exercises.q: Никогда не думал, что мы вот так вот ___ (кончить).
exercises.prompt: I never imagined we'd end up like this.

exercises.q: Не ___ (понять), где у него спина, где брюхо.
exercises.prompt: You don't get where his back is, and where his belly is.
The ice is going to break under your weight.
Let's make a list.
Can you tell me the time?
Why don't we slow down?
Wait until the crowd scatters.

exercises.q: Выпьем, ___ (закусить), о делах наших скорбных покалякаем.
exercises.prompt: Let's drink, eat, and talk about our woeful deeds.
The lilies of the valley will flower soon.
Maybe I'll shave my head.
Could you hand me the remote?
We'll do without it.

exercises.q: Изучение клингона сильно ___ (помочь) его карьере бизнесмена.
exercises.prompt: Learning Klingon will be of great use for his career as a businessman.
I'll carry this suitcase for you.
They will release the hostages.
Melt the butter in a saucepan.
Will you dance with me?

exercises.q: Я ___ (принять) это, как само собой разумеющееся.
exercises.prompt: I'll take that for granted.

exercises.q: Меня не ___ (выписать), пока я не выздоровлю.
exercises.prompt: I won't be discharged until I'm cured.
You'll be punished if you break the law.
Your hair will grow back.
I'll gouge out your eyes!

exercises.q: Когда я пукну, и сановники начнут смеяться надо мной, ___ (обнажить) мечи.
exercises.prompt: When I fart and the dignitaries begin laughing at me, draw your swords.
We'll send her a card.

exercises.q: Эй, этот узел никуда не годится. Лодка ___ (уплыть).
exercises.prompt: Hey, that knot is no good. The boat will float away.
Let's stop at the next gas station.
Tom always gets rowdy when he drinks tequila.
This medicine will ease your cramps.
It'll only make matters worse.

exercises.q: Мы ___ (выиграть) время, если пойдём напрямик через поле.
exercises.prompt: It'll save time if we cut across the field.
These lilies smell lovely.

exercises.q: Давайте ___ (разделиться) на небольшие группы по четыре-пять человек.
exercises.prompt: Let's split into small groups of four or five people.

exercises.q: Скоро ___ (наступить) новый год по григорианскому календарю.
exercises.prompt: A new year of the Gregorian calendar will soon begin.
I'll deal with Tom later.
The nurse will treat the patient's wound.
These flowers are just about to bloom.

exercises.q: Беспилотники ___ (пригодиться) для перевозки жизненно важных лекарств.
exercises.prompt: Drones will be useful for transporting life-saving drugs.

exercises.q: ___ (сложить) этот листок пополам вертикально, потом горизонтально.
exercises.prompt: Fold this sheet in half vertically and horizontally.
Let's synchronize our watches.
Maybe this'll cheer you up.
How long does it last?

exercises.q: ___ (сжать) я губы бутоном, чтобы не сболтнуть лишнего.
exercises.prompt: I gonna button my lips so the truth don't slip.
I'm not going to be afraid again.
How long will you be staying?

exercises.q: Диме безразлично, ___ (выполнить) он работу или нет.
exercises.prompt: Dima doesn't care whether he accomplish the job or not.
This particle turns a noun into a verb.

exercises.q: Дождик, дождик, перестань. Я ___ (поехать) в Аристань.
exercises.prompt: Rain, rain, go away. Come again another day.
Do you think they'll be offended?
Whip him until he confesses.

exercises.q: Давайте ___ (начать) загодя. Я не люблю рисковать.
exercises.prompt: Let's start in plenty of time. I don't like to take risks.

exercises.q: Шеф нас за это по головке не ___ (погладить).
exercises.prompt: The boss won't pat us on the head for that.
I hope I don't botch the job.
Let's get a picture of us with the sea in the background.

exercises.q: Господи! Ну борода у Вас! Выглядите ужасно! Вы всех детей ___ (распугать)!
exercises.prompt: God! What a beard you have! You look terrible! You're going to scare away the children.

exercises.q: Капиталисты ___ (продать) нам верёвку, на которой мы их повесим.
exercises.prompt: The Capitalists will sell us the rope with which we will hang them.
Let's just take a break.
